prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Confirm Pet Appearance on Desktop", "Check your screen to verify your pet rendered properly before completing setup.", "Pet Is Visible"]
1: ["Choose Your Journey", "Scroll to explore companion paths and pick how you want to bring your pet to life."]
2: ["Secure Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in to bind your newly created companion to your account so you never lose them."]
3: ["Listen to Voice & Sound Cues", "Test your companion's vocalizations and sound effects before adoption.", "Play sound sample"]
4: ["Useful tips while your pet is generated"]
5: ["Unlocks special desktop animations and audio cues!"]
6: ["Sign In to Keep & Restore Your Pets", "Signing in ensures your desktop companion and save state are safely linked to your account."]
7: []
8: ["Tip: Right-click the system tray icon anytime to open controls, converse, or minimize your pet."]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Review your companion's details and finalize adoption to bring them to your desktop."]
